summary: The existing installer and boundary-hash findings are resolved in the candidate source and supported by bound passing CI evidence. The transition disclosure still misses the approved plan's requirement to expose exact UTC timestamps without hover. No files were modified and no builds were executed.

findings.summary: Render exact UTC timestamps visibly inside the observed-path disclosure. renderFlowDiagram uses paintTime for trace hops, which places only the relative label in textContent and stores the exact timestamp solely in datetime/title attributes. Opening the disclosure therefore does not expose exact timestamps without hover, contrary to the approved plan. Add visible exact timestamp text and a corresponding browser assertion.
findings.reproduction: Open a task with observed transitions and expand Observed event path. Inspect a hop whose TimeView contains a relative label and an exact UTC timestamp.
findings.expected: The expanded disclosure visibly provides the exact UTC timestamp using keyboard or touch without requiring hover.
findings.actual: The hop displays only the relative time; the exact timestamp exists only in datetime and title attributes.
